# The Magick Muse

> The Magick Muse (magickmuse.com) is a witchcraft education site built around The Magick Manuscript: a members' online grimoire of 20,000+ cross-linked pages across 15 grimoires (plants, crystals, oils, animals, entities and deities, astrology, timing, runes, symbols, tarot, rituals, recipes, materials, dreams and correspondences), researched from published books with sources cited.

Members also get tools built on the research: a calendar of festivals and moon phases they can add to Google, Apple or Outlook (in their own time zone, each event linked to its page), Today's Correspondences, Draw a Card (daily tarot), 300+ tarot spreads to deal digitally or at the altar, a Dream Decoder, Planetary Hours from their own sunrise and sunset, Pull a Rune (Elder Futhark or Witch's Runes), a Spell Builder, Correspondence Wheels, private notes on any page, and a 30-day beginner path.

The site is for practising witches of any path, beginners included. It is not tied to Wicca or any one tradition, and it favours sourced information over guesswork.

## The Magick Manuscript

- [The Magick Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/grimoires): what is inside the 15 grimoires and how they link together
- [Join the Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/join): membership, monthly or lifetime
- [Today's Correspondences](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/today): free daily page with the moon phase, the planet ruling the day, the Sun's sign and the season, and what suits them
- [Calendar feed](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/calendar.ics): festivals and moon phases for Google, Apple or Outlook calendars

## Learning and shop

- [Magick Mastery](https://magickmuse.com/mastery): guides, self-paced beginner courses and the blog
- [The Market](https://magickmuse.com/market): courses (Witchcraft 101 and 111), Notion grimoire templates, and a free Crystal Grimoire template
- [The Magick Muses](https://magickmuse.com/muses): a free Discord community of 950+ practitioners
- [Our story](https://magickmuse.com/mythos): how the Manuscript began

## Blog

- [Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets](https://magickmuse.com/blog/astrology-for-witches): You don't need a birth chart to time a spell. The seven planets, moon phases, and moon signs, and how to layer them without obsessing.
- [Candle Magick for Beginners: Colors, Anointing & Reading the Flame](https://magickmuse.com/blog/candle-magick-for-beginners): Candle magick is one of the simplest ways to start casting. Learn candle color meanings, how to anoint a candle, fire safety, and how to read the flame and wax.
- [Crystals for Beginners: How Witches Choose, Cleanse & Use Them](https://magickmuse.com/blog/crystals-for-beginners): Amethyst, citrine, clear quartz, and five more starter stones, plus how to cleanse, charge, and spot fakes before they end up on your altar.
- [Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar](https://magickmuse.com/blog/essential-witch-tools-for-beginners): Forget the Pinterest altar. The handful of tools a new witch uses most, and how to set up a working altar in a whole room or a shoebox.
- [Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely](https://magickmuse.com/blog/herbalism-for-witches): Rose petals for romance, bay leaves for luck. Plant magick is everywhere, and working with it safely starts with knowing your herbs.
- [Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-my-witchcraft-practice-has-changed): Over ten years of practice, a lot has shifted. What I've unlearned, what I trust now, and what I'd tell my beginner self if I could.
- [How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-cast-a-spell-for-beginners): Candles, jars, sachets, and sigils each do something different. How to build each one, and why every spell starts with a clear intention.
- [How to Celebrate Samhain: Rituals, Divination & Ancestor Work](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-celebrate-samhain): Samhain is the witch's new year, when the veil grows thin. Learn its history, when to celebrate, and simple rituals for honoring your ancestors.
- [How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-dispose-of-a-spell): The candle burned out. Now what? Burying, burning, crossroads, running water, and the trash can, matched to the working they came from.
- [Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-find-reliable-witchcraft-information): Black tourmaline protects, or it's dangerous, or it needs a full moon first. Sorting real knowledge from confident guesswork, one red flag at a time.
- [How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-research-witchcraft): Every book gives a different answer, and so does every website. Research is how a witch cuts through the noise, and anyone can build the skill.
- [Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-ancestors-witchcraft): Your ancestors are the closest spirits you have. A simple altar, the right offerings, and a real relationship, even without a family tree.
- [Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-deities-witchcraft): "Which deity is calling me?" is usually the wrong first question. Approaching gods with patience, research, and respect, and what silence can mean.
- [Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-greek-gods): Kharis is the heart of Hellenic worship, a relationship built on gifts, gratitude, and showing up. Meet the Olympians and start the right way.
- [The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick](https://magickmuse.com/blog/law-of-similars-witchcraft): Why red for love and green for money? Meet the Law of Similars, the principle behind nearly every spell, and start reading your tools like a witch.
- [Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus](https://magickmuse.com/blog/meditation-for-witches-beginners): Meditation doesn't mean an empty mind. Five minutes of breath, a little time outside, and simple grounding can change how your spellwork feels.
- [Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing](https://magickmuse.com/blog/protection-magick-for-beginners): Before you manifest anything, protect what you have. Shields, wards, banishing, and the small daily habits that make a protection practice hold.
- [Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark](https://magickmuse.com/blog/runes-for-beginners): Rune doesn't mean letter. It means secret. A grounded introduction to the Elder Futhark, from Odin's ordeal to your first three-rune spread.
- [What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-a-correspondence-in-witchcraft): Black tourmaline for protection, Friday for love. A correspondence is energy shared between things, and it's the idea that holds spellwork together.
- [What Is Baneful Magick? Hexes, Curses, Bindings & Ethics](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-baneful-magick): Hexes, curses, bindings, and banishing. What each one means, how witches think about the ethics, and what to ask before you ever work it.
- [Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-divination-witchcraft): Tarot is one tool in a much bigger box. Signs, runes, pendulums, scrying, and more, with a simple way to find the method that fits you.
- [Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-shadow-work-witchcraft): You can't know anything else until you know yourself. Where shadow work comes from, how it shows up in your craft, and how to start gently.
- [Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-to-do-with-your-first-tarot-deck): You don't have to be gifted your first deck. Choosing one, cleansing and bonding with it, and interviewing it before your first real reading.
- [What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-to-include-in-a-grimoire): A grimoire and a Book of Shadows aren't the same thing. A tour of the sections inside The Magick Manuscript, and how to decide what goes in yours.
- [Can You Be a Witch Without Being Wiccan?](https://magickmuse.com/blog/witch-without-wicca): Wicca is a religion. Witchcraft is a practice. Learn the difference, where the Threefold Law comes from, and how to find your own path as a witch.
- [Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List](https://magickmuse.com/blog/witchcraft-books-for-beginners): Some witchcraft books are excellent and some just have nice covers. A beginner reading list by topic, drawn from the shelf that built the Manuscript.
